title: Ionic Swap
tagline: Unified DeFi interface with chain abstraction—swap assets cross-chain gaslessly, fully on-chain
description: I’m building a fully on-chain gasless cross-chain swap dApp using 1inch architecture and ICP’s ChainFusion. The idea is to let users swap assets across EVM, ICP, and even Solana—without needing gas tokens. Smart contracts deployed on ICP will handle intent verification and trigger MEV-protected swaps via 1inch. Any wallet, no bridges, just a clean, gasless UX.
how_its_made:
Core Architecture
Backend: Rust canister on Internet Computer using ic-cdk for cross-chain coordination
Frontend: React + Vite with Tailwind CSS for modern UI
Smart Contracts: Solidity 0.8.23 with OpenZeppelin libraries for EVM chains

MEV-protected swaps via 1inch. Any wallet, no bridges, just a clean, gasless UX.
